correctness.rationale: Read defining Akhtarshenas arXiv:quant-ph/0311166v3 Eq.(26)-(31) and rendered page 6. In three qubits each i,j SO(2) generator is unique and squared pair norm equals spin-flip overlap Tr(rho_ij tilde rho_ij). The two-qubit universal spin-flip gives 1-Tr rho_i^2-Tr rho_j^2+Tr rho_ij^2; complementary-state spectra for global purity yield Tr rho_ij^2=Tr rho_k^2. Defining T_i=2(1-Tr rho_i^2) therefore gives A_ij^2=(T_i+T_j-T_k)/2; inserting CKW monogamy T_i=c_ij^2+c_ik^2+tau gives c_ij^2+tau/2. Summing equals (T1+T2+T3)/2=3Q/2 by Q=(sum T_i)/3. Checks GHZ: A=1/sqrt2 despite c=0, W: A=2/3 with tau0, and Bell pair+product: one A=1 other zero. Correct domain pure 3 qubits; no higher-dimensional or mixed-state claim.
